🎨 Design Asset Management

Centralized management and distribution of design assets for the Chassis Design System.

🚀 Getting Started

Chassis Assets provides a structured approach to managing design assets across different brands and applications.

📁 Asset Organization

Structured directory system for fonts, images, and icons across multiple brands.

🔄 Build System

Automated processing and optimization of assets for different platforms.

📊 Asset Analysis

Built-in tools to analyze and report on asset usage and optimization.

📂 Directory Structure

source/
├── default/              # Fallback assets for all brands
│   ├── web/             # Web application assets
│   │   ├── fonts/       # Typography assets
│   │   ├── images/      # Bitmap images and illustrations
│   │   └── icons/       # Icon assets (SVG preferred)
│   └── mobile/          # Mobile application assets
└── [brand]/             # Brand-specific overrides
    └── [app]/           # Application-specific assets
        ├── fonts/
        ├── images/
        └── icons/

🛠️ Available Commands

npm run build Build all assets for all brands
npm run analyze Analyze asset usage and optimization opportunities
npm run copy Copy assets to target directories
